brief:
A Palestinian died from injuries sustained in Thursday's Israeli air strike on Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, raising the death toll to seven, Middle East Eye reported. The strike struck one of Gaza's largest hospitals as medical staff struggle with shortages of fuel and supplies.

The attack came as Israel continues its military operations in Gaza, where hospitals have faced mounting pressure from overwhelming numbers of wounded and displaced civilians.

title: Israeli strike on Nasser Medical Complex kills seven Palestinians
